description:
In the Northwind Traders business, issuing a credit note for a volume rebate (financial adjustment) rather than a goods return. 

1. Navigate to 'Settings' > 'Chart of Accounts' and create a new account named 'Volume Discounts' (Type: Expense). 
2. Navigate to 'Credit Notes' and create a new credit note for customer 'Alfreds Futterkiste'. 
3. Set the Date to today and Description to 'Q1 Volume Rebate'. 
4. In the line items, DO NOT select an Inventory Item. Instead, select the 'Volume Discounts' account you just created. 
5. Set the Amount to 500.00. 
6. Create the credit note.
